status: Planning only; recommendations pending consolidated review; no runtime changes
constraints: Current logical viewport960x540, floor440, jump apex about86px; prefer <=60px rises and test both heroes.
Current mission accounting assumes one sequential active zone, four active required enemies, and all-defeated advancement. Simply raising spawn totals will preserve stop-and-clear pacing.
Current geometry uses solid rectangles including platform undersides. Catwalk supports must have authored collision independently of decoration to preserve lower route clearance.

Current ordinary enemy runtime primarily supports Flushfiend pursuit plus separate optional swarm hazards; new shooter/flyer/ambusher behavior and enemy projectile ownership need explicit implementation.
Current player shots can hit required monsters and optional swarms. New roles need shared damage/hit ownership and progression accounting, not another incompatible collision path.
Current completion at x9450 and mission completion must be replaced by explicit Clogfather defeat/exit state. Existing toilet-wave ending is provisional.
Keep first-name heroes, existing portrait emotion mapping and checkpoint/no-life-cost semantics.
recommended_staging: Combat sandbox: candidate HP/fire cadence and enemy projectile visibility; compare both heroes including misses.
First20-second playable slice: runner, perched shooter and one telegraphed emergence route; one pickup and supported upper/lower paths.
Expand encounter director with bounded concurrent threats, finite spawn budgets, pressure/recovery rhythm and checkpoint-safe progress.
Add remaining approved monster behaviors and entrance animations incrementally; background/viewer-side actors non-colliding until telegraphed play-plane entry.
Implement Clogfather state machine, full boss art, bounded attacks, defeat and mission completion. Do not mark level complete with fallback waves.
Both-hero full route playtests, difficulty pass, performance/audio/readability, build and authorized storybook screenshots.
verification: HP/hit-count table generated from candidate data; misses and cooldown recovery measured separately from perfect DPS.
Spawn director limits damaging actors/projectiles, prevents offscreen hits and overlap at entry, and cannot deadlock after respawn.
Routes reachable by both heroes; lower lane clearance, one-way/drop-through decision, projectile occlusion and support collision tested.
Exclusive pickups cannot equip wrong owner; loss/death/checkpoint rules explicit and tested.
Boss phase transitions, attack telegraphs, death/reset/skip cleanup and exactly-once completion.
Human first20-second and full-route tests; bot clears alone are not pacing or fairness validation.
